image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a dessert on a white plate. The central subject is a scoop of white ice cream (likely vanilla) topped with dark chocolate syrup drizzles. Surrounding the scoop are pieces of what appear to be wafer cones or cake, also drizzled with red and dark syrups. There is a pool of melted ice cream or cream sauce at the base. A wooden utensil handle is visible in the top right corner.
